views.label: Admission
views.note: Managed runtime-only tasks persist a static contract before receipt and enqueue. Other paths retain strict admission inspections.

views.label: Run and publish
views.note: Inside the guardian scope, fresh capability preflight and strict plan validation must succeed before provider Start.

views.label: Observe and continue
views.note: Collection reads durable evidence; cancellation persists one request, and the lifetime lease selects the sole stopping owner.

messages.label: dispatch --provider / --auto · brief
messages.note: Validate the request and prepare its static provider candidate before binding the private supervisor.

messages.label: otherwise: strict admission inspection
messages.note: Mixed/native policy projections, CCR preparation selection, custom runners and historical tasks keep their strict admission inspection. The inspection returns non-secret facts for strict finalization before task persistence.

messages.label: admit contract; persist immutable task
messages.note: Managed runtime-only profiles use ProfileCandidate.Admit without version/help workers. Immutable metadata stores Meta.RuntimePreflightSHA256 and empty ProviderVersion. Other paths finalize their strict inspection facts before persistence.

messages.label: enqueue that exact numeric row
messages.note: A managed row cannot launch before Delegate durably owns its exact supervisor identity.

messages.label: persist scope intent + registration
messages.note: Persist scope intent, create the native scope, then persist registration before starting the managed worker.

messages.label: acknowledge identity-bound worker
messages.note: The guardian records the observed native child identity before acknowledging hello; the worker waits for that acknowledgement.

messages.label: read receipt and recheck recorded profile
check capability digest; fresh version/help
messages.note: freshPreflightProfile checks the exact required digest and probes this task’s current runtime.

messages.label: Start only after strict validation
messages.note: finalizeCandidate strictly validates; freshPreflightProfile matches the admitted contract before Start. Runtime verification must be complete.

messages.label: close lifetime
messages.note: Before sealing evidence, the runner closes the task lifetime and waits for the guardian acknowledgement.

messages.label: persist termination + empty scope
messages.note: The guardian persists independently proven empty-scope termination before acknowledging the runner close.

messages.label: publish outcome.json: committed or rejected
messages.note: outcome.json is the terminal authority; result.txt and publish.reject are payload evidence.

messages.label: persist exact managed-worker Wait
messages.note: Empty-scope termination was persisted before sealing. After the managed worker exits, the guardian records its exact child Wait before disposing the scope and releasing ownership.

messages.label: observe and reconcile this task
messages.note: Status can recover the exact previously stashed row. Collection can publish an existing seal. Neither creates another provider turn or replays a consumed launch.

messages.label: persist immutable user stop request
messages.note: The durable request is the single cancellation intent; a queue row is never native lifetime authority.

messages.label: active owner: terminate scope + record empty proof
otherwise: stop row while holding lifetime lease
messages.note: Direct row mutation is allowed only when cancellation owns the lease, so no guardian can launch or own a provider concurrently.

cards.title: Admission
items: Managed runtime-only admission uses a static contract; no version/help worker or shared capability cache
Meta.RuntimePreflightSHA256 binds the required capability; ProviderVersion remains empty on the static path
Mixed/native projections, CCR selection, custom runners and historical tasks retain strict admission inspection
An immutable task and exact stashed-row receipt are durable before enqueue

cards.title: Fresh launch authority
items: The managed runner probes the current runtime within its guardian scope and finite task budget
Strict finalization and matching preserve the admitted permission, workspace, environment, predicate and artifacts
Provider Start requires successful fresh preflight; observations from another task cannot authorize execution
The guardian records each observed provider launch before acknowledging it

cards.title: Publication
items: Pueue owns queueing and guardian-row state
The guardian owns native stopping and durable exact child-Wait proof
delegate-run owns provider Start/Wait, capture, and sealing
Only outcome.json establishes a terminal verdict

cards.title: Observation
items: Observation can reconcile the exact stashed submission and publish an existing seal; it never creates another provider turn
Cancellation persists one request; the lifetime lease selects its sole stopping owner
Continuation creates a new task with an exact predecessor

cards.title: Committed source snapshot
items: Node source links identify committed code
Admission and runtime preflight retain separate owners
